live-verifier-custody-tables.about: Assumptions.Zk.RecordCustodyZKJ (live-verifier): RecordCustodyZK at J tables, the record flock-verify verify --zk --session-tables J reads is the one the verifier's live-coin part wrote for the live session, and its draw file the one flock-verify draw printed for the verifier's own subset draw (PROTOCOL.md §17.2: nothing in the record authenticates its writer)

A4-prf-sha512.about: A4 (KeyedStreamsUniform, prf/sha-512): verity.randomness's keyed streams at distinct indices pass a test as independent uniform streams do, up to eta, SHA-512's compression function keyed by a secret first block or by its chaining value being a PRF

live-verifier-custody-exec.about: Assumptions.RecordCustodyExec and RecordCustodyExecH (live-verifier): the record flock-verify verify reads without --zk is the one the verifier's live-coin part wrote for the live session, and its draw file proves the drawn units with the outcome's link points (PROTOCOL.md §17.2: nothing in the record authenticates its writer)

live-verifier-custody-zk-law.about: Assumptions.Zk.RecordCustodyZKLaw, RecordCustodyZKHLaw, RecordCustodyZKJLaw and RecordCustodyZKHJLaw (live-verifier): the record flock-verify verify --zk reads is the one the verifier's live-coin part wrote for the live session, and at every draw of the live law its draw file proves the drawn units with the outcome's link points (PROTOCOL.md §17.2: nothing in the record authenticates its writer)
